caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate candlestick holder rendered in yellow and gold hues. The candlestick holder is shaped in the form of a fish whose body is upright, with the head at the bottom, mouth slightly open, and the tail curving upwards to support the main stem of the holder. The fish has detailed scales, fins, and an expressive eye, and sits on a square base. The main stem of the candlestick, above the fish, has a fluted, floral-like design both at the central shaft and the candle socket at the top, which is shaped in a way that resembles petals opening outward. The drawing sits on a plain, light beige background, and there are four faded, rectangular spots on the corners of the drawing. The overall composition centers the candlestick vertically on the page.
title: Dolphin Candlestick
